'''Nakkis leaf''' was a poisonous plant, medicine from which was a crucial part of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] ritual [[Shko-yagu]]. After fasting, a Trandoshan would drink Nakkis leaf medicine on an empty stomach, forcing the skin to molt, but also leaving them weakened from the leaf's poison. A Trandoshan named [[Veneb Drassk]] used the weakness to kill his rivals for the position of the [[Clan Speaker]] by the means of a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] named [[Gwarror]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />
